visual_qa.scope: Six maintained regression charts and eight charts spanning all six tutorials; plotting-job completion and fresh timestamps checked before each visual inspection. Separate dense horn S11 review is preserved as ignored ad hoc evidence.

plots.notes: Magnitude, wrapped phase, frequency and mode labels are readable. Fundamental transmission is near 0 dB; mode-conversion coefficients sit near the single-precision floor. Verified initial S21 phases decrease smoothly between expected wraps.

Magnitude, wrapped phase, frequency and mode labels are readable. Fundamental transmission is near 0 dB; mode-conversion coefficients sit near the single-precision floor. Verified initial S21 phases decrease smoothly between expected wraps.
All six TE/TM radius comparisons are visible with correct dB/frequency labels. Larger bends substantially improve mean transmission; individual frequency curves can cross.
Both source-profile traces and labels are clear. Broadband profile remains much closer to 0 dB across the band.

Both S21 and refinement panels render correctly. Residuals are about 0.0001 dB; data do not follow the O(delta^2) reference guide and slightly increase with finer spacing. The guide is a reference only, not an empirical convergence result.
Both traces are readable with frequency/dB axes; lossy transmission is about -6.1 dB while non-lossy transmission is near 0 dB.
Clear modal S-parameter plot; -100 dB plotting floor is explicitly labeled and mode-conversion traces reach that floor.
Reflection, transmission, and conversion traces render with consistent mode labels and an explicit -100 dB floor.
Readable S11 curve across 8-12 GHz, 10 GHz design marker, legend and -60 dB floor label.
Clear symmetric principal-plane patterns; xz E-plane and xy H-plane cuts, signed angular axes and gain/directivity units are labeled.
Initial PNG clipped the lowest x tick at 1.0. Adding bbox_inches="tight" to this savefig resolved the crop; corrected PNG visually verified with all axes/ticks and 14.04 dBi peak label visible.
All four dominant-mode S entries render with readable dual magnitude/phase axes. S21 and S12 are visually consistent; unwrapped phase curves are smooth.
Four active-reflection traces and all five beam patterns are visible. Legend distinguishes FDTD and array-factor peak angles; beam squint is clear.
Cutoff shading/marker, generalized-coefficient labels, and analytic comparison are legible. S21 magnitude and phase visually follow TE10 theory; near-cutoff S11 spike is shown rather than hidden.
